verdict.rationale: Kong's GitHub README says it ships plugins for logging and monitoring. The AI Gateway docs show OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics export for generative AI, MCP and A2A traffic, plus request logging and log access. Evidence for general API-traffic observability stays at a one-line plugin mention, and tracing is never shown. Missing for 10: documented distributed-tracing support, named metrics/logging integrations (e.g. specific backends) for general API traffic, in-depth docs for non-AI traffic monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
